description.value: Horin Ramen is a Japanese ramen restaurant tracing its roots to a 1966 Fukuoka Prefecture original that pioneered chili-pepper tonkotsu broth. The Vancouver-area chain revives that legacy with hand-made broth and tare sauce adjusted daily by season and weather. The Burnaby location is situated inside Metropolis at Metrotown, one of BC's largest urban shopping malls.
